pr_body:
This patch changes the Resume() function of the producer and consumer jobs to return an error if the jobs do not complete successfully. This prevents the job state machine from inadvertently entering the `succeeded` state. Note that all consumer job errors are marked as Pausable, ensuring the consumer job still pauses on error. Also note that if the consumer job fails or cancels, the producer job now fails instead of cancels.

This patch also cleans up a few log and error messages.

Fixes #103513, #103512

Release note: None

issue_context.title: c2c: clean up consumer job logic after a pause on error
issue_context.body:
Currently, the ingestion job [pauses on all errors](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/master/pkg/ccl/streamingccl/streamingest/stream_ingestion_job.go#L324), but does not return any errors on Resume, causing the job to go through the state machine with a status "succeeded", which seems misleading and error prone. The job state machine eventually corrects itself and pauses the job.


Jira issue: CRDB-28049

review_comments: i'm not entirely sure we want to fail this job whenever the consumer does not succeed, but I think my approach is simpler and less confusing than cancellation behavior we had before.
